items.title: Sobha adds The Woods Horizon apartments at Sobha Sanctuary
items.summary: One- and two-bedroom apartments in a low-rise setting, recorded as launched on 30 October, with handover planned for Q4 2030. Listings disagree on the payment plan (60/40 or 40/60), so confirm it with Sobha.

items.title: Binghatti lists Binghatti Etherea in JVC
items.summary: Recorded as launched on 22 October, with handover stated for Q1 2028.

items.community: Al Thuraya Island, Sharjah Waterfront City
items.title: Ajmal Makan sets 11 November launch for Verde Villas
items.summary: 32 four-bedroom garden villas of 4,626 sq ft, with completion due in Q4 2028 and refundable EOIs of AED 50,000 open now. Overseas buyers pay 20% down and 10% during construction instead of the 10/20 split.

items.title: Emaar opens sales at Valia, first homes in Dubai Square district
items.summary: A 53- to 56-storey tower of 491 one- to four-bedroom apartments beside Dubai Square Mall, with completion expected in the second half of 2030. Emaar's site lists a starting price of AED 1.96M; the launch report quoted AED 2.06M.

items.title: Vision breaks ground on 246-unit Sera Gardens
items.summary: Construction has started on the G+P+8+R building launched in May, with studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments and three- and four-bedroom duplexes. It is the developer's third project in the area.
